ITEM 1 | Pale golden-cream baked mass with a slightly bumpy, set surface and some browned spots, cut into an irregular wedge about 8 cm across and 2-3 cm tall, sitting at the upper right of the plate | 120
ITEM 2 | Scattered pale beige cooked beans or pale chunks, plump and smooth-skinned, about 1-1.5 cm each, mixed among the wedge and at its lower edge | 35
ITEM 3 | Thin strands and flecks of pale yellow-green and light onion-like pieces, soft and slightly glossy, woven through the top of the wedge | 10
ITEM 4 | Dark green wilted leaves, some flat and some curled, glossy with slight moisture, spread over the right side of the wedge and trailing down toward the bottom edge, about 6 cm long | 12
ITEM 5 | Bright orange cooked carrot pieces, soft and glossy, cut into a roughly 4 cm elongated strip lying across the lower middle of the food | 15
ITEM 6 | Small crumbly golden-brown bits, dry and irregular, scattered on the plate near the left edge of the wedge | 2
ITEM 7 | Pale cream-white soft chunk with a moist surface, sitting at the lower left of the wedge, about 3 cm across | 20
